title: Adhyaya 12: Classical Duties & Dharma
summary: Canonical verses on traditional righteousness from Adhyaya 12.
ai_summary: Exposition of ethical conduct and cosmic law according to Sage Manu in Adhyaya 12.

verses.original: शुभेन कर्मणा याति देवत्वं शुभगो जनः । मिश्रैर्मनुष्यतामेति पापैस्तिर्यक्त्वमाप्नुयात् ॥
verses.transliteration: śubhena karmaṇā yāti devatvaṁ śubhago janaḥ | miśrairmanuṣyatāmeti pāpaistiryakttvamāpnuyāt ||
verses.translation: Through auspicious and virtuous action a person attains divine states; through mixed actions one is born as human; through sinful actions one falls into lower forms of existence.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The universal law of moral cause and effect (Karma-vipaka) governing transmigration.

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: Through auspicious and virtuous action a person attains divine states; through mixed actions one is born as human; through sinful actions one falls into lower forms of existence.

layers.author: buhler
layers.author_label: Sacred Books of the East Vol 25
layers.content: मनुस्मृती अध्याय 12: The universal law of moral cause and effect (Karma-vipaka) governing transmigration.

verses.original: सर्वमात्मनि संपश्येत्सच्चासच्च समाहितः । सर्वं ह्यात्मनि संपश्यन्नाधर्मे कुरुते मनः ॥
verses.transliteration: sarvamātmani saṁpaśyetsaccāsacca samāhitaḥ | sarvaṁ hyātmani saṁpaśyannādharme kurute manaḥ ||
verses.translation: With serene focused mind, let him behold all things — the real and the unreal — within the Self; for beholding all things within the Self, he never turns his mind toward unrighteousness.

layers.author: medhatithi
layers.content: The ultimate conclusion of Manusmriti: cosmic Self-realization establishes unbroken righteousness and supreme liberation (Moksha).

layers.author: kulluka-bhatta
layers.content: कुल्लूक भट्ट भाष्य: With serene focused mind, let him behold all things — the real and the unreal — within the Self; for beholding all things within the Self, he never turns his mind toward unrighteousness.
